notes.title: Update Notes (September 2025)
notes.content:
Apologies for leaving this for so long, but times have been rough.

I have hopefully some of the major issues:
[list]
[*]Customers not leaving after being served.
[*]Not being able to stop interactions with the cat bed.
[*]Revenue not showing full amount at end of day. (Was only showing tips)
[*]Length of day is now 100 seconds rather than 60.
[*]Added ability to leave minigames via button on top right (or RB on controller).
[*]Fix for some books being transparent on shelves.
[/list]

notes.title: New Minigame
notes.content:
### Build - 2024/11/16 - 0.3.1

- Added new minigame for serving customers.
  * Drag the sale stamp to the highlighted location if the customer has no library card, or it is expired.
  * If the customer has a library card that is in date, use the loan stamp.
- Small alterations for some translated text and text scaling on Main Menu.

tags.feature: - Added new minigame for serving customers.

notes.title: Update 2024/07/24
notes.content:
Apologies for the slower updates, life has been getting in the way!
I hope anyone that's played has enjoyed the beta, but to make it easier, new games now start with 500 coins.
Enjoy!
